extracted.intended_audience: poets, fiction writers, and nonfiction writers considering applying to or attending the Sewanee Writers’ Conference
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and logistical requirements for applying to and attending the Sewanee Writers’ Conference (submission packet, deadlines, cost, fellowship eligibility, and accessibility). Relevant to writers preparing application materials for workshops, one-on-one meetings, and readings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission packet length (poetry)
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers submitted 10 to 15 pages of poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a packet of 10–15 pages of poetry by the stated deadline (March 15). This is the expected sample size for poetry applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission packet length (prose)
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers submitted 20 to 30 pages of prose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit a packet of 20–30 pages of prose by the stated deadline (March 15). This is the expected sample size for fiction and nonfiction applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application deadline
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All application materials (poetry or prose packet) must be submitted by March 15 to be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application fee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are not charged an application fee to apply to this conference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tuition and what it includes
rubrics_metrics.description: Tuition, including room and board, was $2,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attending the conference requires payment of tuition; the stated cost covers both tuition and on-site room and board. Budget accordingly or seek financial aid/fellowships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowships and scholarships availability and eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships and scholarships were available for published writers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial aid (fellowships/scholarships) exists and is targeted toward writers who have prior publication; applicants who are published should investigate eligibility and application process on the conference website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres and program focus
rubrics_metrics.description: The conference featured workshops, special topics classes, lectures, one-on-one meetings with faculty, and readings for poets, fiction writers, and nonfiction writers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program supports poetry, fiction, and nonfiction tracks; applicants should prepare materials appropriate to their genre and expect workshops, classes, lectures, one-on-one faculty meetings, and readings as central activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty and publishing professional participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Faculty included named poets, fiction writers, and nonfiction writers; participating publishing professionals included agents and editors (examples: Sarah Burnes, Annie Hwang, Gerald Maa, Jessica Q. Stark).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The conference provides access to a roster of established faculty and visiting publishing professionals; applicants can expect potential mentorship and networking opportunities with agents and editors. Review faculty and professionals on the conference website to tailor submission and goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility accommodations
rubrics_metrics.description: Accessibility accommodations include elevators in all multilevel event spaces and accessible parking. Contact associate director of marketing and admission Adam Latham at allatham@sewanee.edu for additional accessibility details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attendees with access needs should contact the listed staff member for details and further accommodations. The conference indicates baseline accessibility (elevators, parking) but invites applicants/attendees to request additional support.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to get more information / contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Website: https://sewaneewriters.org; Contact information: Sewanee Writers’ Conference, University of the South, 735 University Avenue, Sewanee, TN 37383.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For full application instructions, fellowship details, and up-to-date logistics, consult the official conference website or use the provided contact/address to request information.
